title: Redstone Activator
description:
The Redstone Activator temporarily powers blocks with redstone when you right click them. For example Doors open, tnt ignites, lamps / redstone turns on.

You can change the duration of the signal between 2 / 20 / 100 Ticks by (shift)-right clicking into the air with it. The default is 20 ticks and the tooltip shows the current duration. The signal has a strength of 15 and the clicked block itself is the one that gets powered.
